title: Maintenance of accounts and restrictions of expenditure

versions.Latest:
191. Maintenance of accounts and restrictions of expenditure.—

—   (1) Accounts of 
the income and expenditure of the Zilla Panchayat Fund shall be kept in accordance with 
such rules as may be prescribed. 
(2) Expenditure from the Zilla Panchayat Fund shall, save as otherwise expressly 
provided for in this Act be incurred subject to such sanctions, conditions and limitations 
as may be prescribed. 
(3) The Zilla Panchayat shall within a period not exceeding three months after the 
close of the financial year, pass the accounts of that year.
